title: t4t5/omdrop-owl
why_read: A niche but genuinely useful interoperability tool that reimplements Apple's AirDrop protocol for non-Apple devices, interesting mainly to people who need cross-platform file sharing without cloud services.
analysis: This project reverse-engineers Apple's proprietary AirDrop protocol so that non-Apple devices (presumably Linux, Windows, Android) can send and receive files directly with Apple devices. That's a nontrivial reverse-engineering and protocol-compatibility effort, since AirDrop uses undocumented BLE and Wi-Fi Direct mechanisms layered with Apple-specific crypto. It's a solid practical utility for a specific cross-platform-interop use case rather than a broadly applicable technical advance.
